title: Customisation Frontmatter
description: Schema for YAML frontmatter across the four customisation artefact types (instruction, prompt, agent, skill). Canonical source: docs/conventions.md §'Frontmatter schema'.

name.description: Display name shown in the UI. Defaults to the file name.

description.description: Short description shown on hover in the Chat view.

applyTo.description: Glob pattern defining which files the instructions apply to automatically, relative to the workspace root.

name.description: The name of the prompt, used after typing / in chat. Defaults to the file name.

argument-hint.description: Hint text shown in the chat input field.

agent.description: The agent used for running the prompt: ask, agent, plan, or the name of a custom agent.

model.description: The language model used when running the prompt.

tools.description: Tool or tool set names available for this prompt. Use <server>/* for all MCP server tools.

name.description: The name of the custom agent. Defaults to the file name.

description.description: Brief description shown as placeholder text in the chat input field.

argument-hint.description: Hint text shown in the chat input field.

tools.description: Tool or tool set names available for this agent. Use <server>/* for all MCP server tools.

agents.description: Agent names available as subagents. Use * to allow all agents, or [] to prevent any.

model.description: AI model to use. A single model name or a prioritized list tried in order.

user-invocable.description: Whether the agent appears in the agents dropdown (default true).

disable-model-invocation.description: Prevent the agent from being invoked as a subagent by other agents (default false).

target.description: Target environment or context for the custom agent.

mcp-servers.description: MCP server config objects for use with GitHub Copilot (target: github-copilot).

label.description: Display text on the handoff button.

agent.description: Target agent identifier to switch to.

prompt.description: Prompt text to send to the target agent.

model.description: Language model to use when the handoff executes.

handoffs.description: Suggested next actions to transition between agents.

hooks.description: Hook commands scoped to this agent (Preview). Same format as hook configuration files.

name.description: Unique identifier. Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only. Must match the parent directory name.

description.description: What the skill does and when to use it.

argument-hint.description: Hint text shown in the chat input field when the skill is invoked as a slash command.

license.description: License name or reference to a bundled license file.

compatibility.description: Environment requirements (intended product, system packages, network access).

allowed-tools.description: Space-separated string of pre-approved tools the skill may use (experimental).

user-invocable.description: Whether the skill appears as a slash command in the / menu (default true).

disable-model-invocation.description: Whether to require manual invocation only, preventing automatic loading (default false).

context.description: How the skill is loaded: inline (default) adds to parent context, fork runs in a dedicated subagent (experimental).

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value pairs for additional metadata.
